description: This file implements a video decoder for AV1 codec using the dav1d library, handling decoding, frame output, and error management within a media playback system.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that manages AV1 video decoding using the dav1d library, supporting initialization, input buffer processing, end-of-stream handling, and decode target management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the decoder with callback functions for status updates and error reporting.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers containing encoded video data into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the input stream, prompting the decoder to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, releasing resources and clearing internal buffers.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the current decode target with a new video frame.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error message via the error callback.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the dav1d decoding context with specific settings.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Releases the dav1d decoding context and associated resources.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer, handling data wrapping, sending data to dav1d, and outputting frames.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles flushing remaining frames at stream end, with timeout management.

methods.name: TryToOutputFrames
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and output decoded frames from dav1d.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering when in decode-to-texture mode.
